title: Midnight Knafeh Dessert
description: A rich, creamy dessert inspired by the flavors of the Middle East.
instructions: In a saucepan, combine midnight and water. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
Add knafeh, nutty, stir, fry, sugar, and vanilla to the saucepan. Stir until well combined.
Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the dessert has reached the desired consistency.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let cool slightly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional midnight if desired.
